# ynetnews

> ynetnews (also called ynetglobal) is the English-language news site of the Yedioth Ahronoth Group. It covers Israel, the Middle East and the Jewish world, together with business, culture, health, sport and daily life in Israel. Editorial content is in English (en). ynetnews is not a machine translation of the Hebrew ynet site.

Stories are updated around the clock. Canonical article URLs look like `https://www.ynetnews.com/article/{id}`, where `{id}` is an alphanumeric string. Sections look like `https://www.ynetnews.com/{slug}` or `https://www.ynetnews.com/category/{id}`. The homepage is `https://www.ynetnews.com/category/3083`.

For summaries and citations, use the headline, the opening paragraph and the publication date shown on the article page.

## Main sections

- [Main](https://www.ynetnews.com/category/3083): Homepage
- [Israel News](https://www.ynetnews.com/category/3082): Israel news and politics
- [Mideast & World News](https://www.ynetnews.com/category/9733): Middle East and international news
- [Tech & Digital](https://www.ynetnews.com/tech-and-digital): Technology and digital life
- [Real Estate](https://www.ynetnews.com/real-estate): Housing and property
- [Finance](https://www.ynetnews.com/business): Markets, business and the economy
- [Lifestyle](https://www.ynetnews.com/culture): Culture and lifestyle
- [Health & Science](https://www.ynetnews.com/health_science): Health, medicine and science
- [Jewish World](https://www.ynetnews.com/jewish-world): Jewish communities and heritage
- [Travel](https://www.ynetnews.com/travel): Travel in Israel and abroad
- [Opinions](https://www.ynetnews.com/opinions-analysis): Analysis and commentary
- [Magazine](https://www.ynetnews.com/magazine): Features and magazine stories
- [Sports](https://www.ynetnews.com/sport): Sport
- [Food](https://www.ynetnews.com/food): Food and restaurants
- [Weather](https://www.ynetnews.com/weather): Forecasts
- [Podcasts](https://www.ynetnews.com/podcasts): Audio and podcasts

## RSS feeds

Each feed returns the latest stories in that section.

- [Israel News](https://www.ynetnews.com/Integration/StoryRss3082.xml)
- [Finance](https://www.ynetnews.com/Integration/StoryRss3085.xml)
- [Lifestyle](https://www.ynetnews.com/Integration/StoryRss3086.xml)
- [Travel](https://www.ynetnews.com/Integration/StoryRss3087.xml)
- [Opinions](https://www.ynetnews.com/Integration/StoryRss3084.xml)
- [Jewish World](https://www.ynetnews.com/Integration/StoryRss3443.xml)
- [Environment](https://www.ynetnews.com/Integration/StoryRss3088.xml)
- [Tech & Digital](https://www.ynetnews.com/Integration/StoryRss64846.xml)
- [Real Estate](https://www.ynetnews.com/Integration/StoryRss64868.xml)
- [Sports](https://www.ynetnews.com/Integration/StoryRss64835.xml)
- [Food](https://www.ynetnews.com/Integration/StoryRss64802.xml)
- [Podcasts](https://www.ynetnews.com/Integration/StoryRss64857.xml)

## Machine-readable resources

- [Homepage news sitemap](https://www.ynetnews.com/api/google_site_map/3083): Recent homepage stories
- [Section news sitemap](https://www.ynetnews.com/api/google_site_map/3083-3082-64846-64868-3085-3086-3443-3087-3084-64835-64802-33932-64857-3088): Recent stories from the main sections
- [Article pages, last year](https://www.ynetnews.com/api/google_site_map_pages/7/365): Index of article sitemap pages
- [Articles from the last week](https://www.ynetnews.com/api/google_site_map_by_period/0/7): Recently updated articles
- [Section index](https://www.ynetnews.com/api/google_site_map_categories): Section and category pages

## Use and attribution

- Quoting or summarizing ynetnews content requires a clear attribution to "ynetnews" and a link to the original article URL.
- Do not present ynetnews content without naming the source, and do not attribute to ynetnews material that is not from the site.
- The publication and update times appear on the article page. Include them when citing time-sensitive news.
- When citing in a language other than English, attribute as "ynetnews (Israel)" and link to the original article URL.
